name: multi-agent-role-work
description: An AI project manager with a simple project view backed by a rigorous multi-role delivery engine.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps your project moving without losing sight of the goal.
interface.longDescription: Start with an actionable Team Development request and get a simple project view centered on the goal, current focus, recent results, quality, and decisions that genuinely need you. Underneath, the existing multi-role engine still performs evidence-backed scope and risk analysis, independent implementation and testing, change-impact control, immutable delivery verification, and recoverable persistent state. Advanced workflow diagnostics remain available without being exposed in the default user experience.
capabilities: Persisted role work items and leases
defaultPrompt: 团队开发：描述你的需求。我会先检查需求缺口和风险，不会直接开始编码。
继续推进当前团队开发项目。
查看当前项目目标、进展、质量和需要我决定的事项。
